De Caipira a Mestre Espadachim 2ª Temporada
anilist.description:
Beryl Gardenant, a swordmaster from the countryside, is settling into his new life as a special instructor for the Royal Order of Knights and the guardian of an orphan. A peaceful life is not in the cards, however, and Beryl is confronted with new obstacles. At the magic institute, in his hometown, at the kingdom's border, away in a foreign land... It's time for Beryl to face new battles.

(Source: Prime Video)

schedule.description:
The second season of Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru.

Beryl Gardenant, a swordmaster from the countryside, is settling into his new life as a special instructor for the Royal Order of Knights and the guardian of an orphan. A peaceful life is not in the cards, however, and Beryl is confronted with new obstacles. At the magic institute, in his hometown, at the kingdom's border, away in a foreign land... It's time for Beryl to face new battles.

(Source: Prime Video)

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Takes On a New Position

titles.ja: 片田舎のおっさん, 新たな職場に行く
titles.en: The Old Country Bumpkin Takes On a New Position
titles.de: Das Landei übernimmt eine neue Stelle
titles.x-jat: Katainaka no Ossan, Arata na Shokuba ni Iku

episodes.overview: A few months into his appointment as the Liberion Order's special instructor, Beryl Gardenant is settling into his new life in the capital. One day, he's visited by Lucy and Ficelle, who ask him to become a temporary instructor at the Magic Institute. Beryl joins the sword magic course where Mewi is enrolled, witnesses Ficelle's teaching methods, and finds himself facing off against her...

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Watches Them Grow

titles.ja: 片田舎のおっさん, 成長を見守る
titles.en: The Old Country Bumpkin Watches Them Grow
titles.de: Das Landei sieht ihnen beim Wachsen zu
titles.x-jat: Katainaka no Ossan, Seichou o Mimamoru

episodes.overview: Beryl wrestles with teaching Ficelle - who is a terrible teacher - how to actually teach. Mewi struggles to fit in with her fellow students, but a conversation with Cindy at lunch hints at that beginning to change. At a small party, Beryl views both Mewi and Ficelle's growth with satisfaction. And then an unexpected disturbance rocks the Magic Institute.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Sees Himself in an Old Man

titles.ja: 片田舎のおっさん, 老輩に己を重ねる
titles.en: The Old Country Bumpkin Sees Himself in an Old Man
titles.de: Das Landei erkennt sich in einem alten Mann wieder
titles.x-jat: Katainaka no Ossan, Rouhai ni Onore o Kasaneru

episodes.overview: Wolf-shaped shadows attack the teachers and magic is rendered useless on campus. Able to fight even without magic, Beryl and Ficelle force their way into the school in an effort to uncover the cause of the strange happenings. When shadow wolves appear in the cafeteria, Mewi and her classmates decide to confront them, despite their inexperience. Two battles unfold - so how will they end?

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Returns Home

titles.ja: 片田舎のおっさん, 帰省する
titles.en: The Old Country Bumpkin Returns Home

episodes.overview: A letter addressed to Beryl arrives from Beaden. Sent by his father Mordea, it urges him to return to the village for an annual event unique to the village. With the Magic Institute on summer break, Beryl invites Mewi to accompany him and Henblitz. Then Curuni invites herself along. It's the first time Beryl's been home since his move to the city. The next day, an unexpected confrontation occurs.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Lets Out a Roar

titles.ja: 片田舎のおっさん, 雄叫びをあげる
titles.en: The Old Country Bumpkin Lets Out a Roar
titles.x-jat: Katainaka no Ossan, Otakebi o Ageru

episodes.overview: Their mission to take down the saberboar begins. Curuni achieves her long-cherished goal of taking one down and realizes how much stronger she has become. Randrid makes full use of the skills he honed as an adventurer and puts his swordsmanship to good use. Impressed, Henblitz challenges him to a sparring match - which ignites something in the hearts of both Beryl and another swordsman.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Faces Off Against His Father

titles.ja: 片田舎のおっさん, 父と対峙する
titles.en: The Old Country Bumpkin Faces Off Against His Father
titles.x-jat: Katainaka no Ossan, Chichi to Taiji Suru

episodes.overview: With the saberboar threat eliminated, Beaden holds its annual festival. The friendship between Henblitz and Randrid grows, while Adel and Edel fuss over Mewi. Beryl watches it all and reflects on his own feelings over the years. Then Mordea arrives and the two head for the dojo. Can Beryl overcome the giant wall that is his father?

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets an Invitation from Nobility

titles.ja: 片田舎のおっさん, 貴族に招かれる
titles.en: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets an Invitation from Nobility
titles.x-jat: Katainaka no Ossan, Kizoku ni Manekareru

episodes.overview: A banquet is being held in the lands of the Margrave of Flumvelk, a region bordering Sphenedyardvania, and both Allucia and Beryl have been invited. The visit is also a chance to confirm the route the soon-to-be-wed Princess Salacia will take to her new home. Along the way, Beryl gives advice to a young knight. When he arrives at his destination, an unexpected reunion awaits him.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets a Marriage Proposal

titles.ja: 片田舎のおっさん, 求婚される
titles.en: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets a Marriage Proposal

episodes.overview: Shueste, the sister of Beryl's former student Warren, relentlessly pursues Beryl - but for a good reason. Seeing this upsets Allucia, Warren explains both his and Shueste's motives, and encourages Allucia to make her own move. Beryl's actions at the banquet leave Shueste even more smitten. Having finished their assignment, Beryl and Allucia head home - but face an unforseen encounter on the way.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes to the Holy City

titles.ja: 片田舎のおっさん, 教都に行く
titles.en: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes to the Holy City
titles.x-jat: Katainaka no Ossan, Kyouto ni Iku

episodes.overview: Back in the capital, Beryl struggles to shake his guilt over Vesper's grave injuries, while Surena tries to cheer him up. The day of Princess Salacia's wedding draws near, and Beryl joins the escort detail. After a short reunion with Shueste and with the threat of an attack by the Verdapis Mercenary Company looming, they reach Dilmahakha, the holy city of Sphenedyardvania. But who is watching him?

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Sees in the New Year

titles.ja: 片田舎のおっさん, 新年を迎える
titles.en: The Old Country Bumpkin Sees in the New Year
titles.x-jat: Katainaka no Ossan, Shinnen o Mukaeru

episodes.overview: Allucia and Gatoga visit Beryl at his lodgings in Dilmahakha, and Gatoga shows Beryl around the city. Once they're alone, Gatoga tells him what became of Rose. Back in Baltrain, Curuni and Ficelle put Mewi through special training, while Lucy and Ibroy meet in secret. The new year arrives, bringing Princess Salacia's wedding - and screams of terror ring out through the cathedral.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Flies into a Rage

titles.ja: 片田舎のおっさん, 激しく憤る
titles.en: The Old Country Bumpkin Flies into a Rage

episodes.overview: The Verdapis Mercenary Company bursts into the cathedral. Beryl moves to stop them, but Ibroy yells, "They're on our side!" Forced into an uneasy alliance, Beryl and the others escort the prince and princess safely to the palace. Along the way, Beryl's rage clashes with Hanoy's pride as a mercenary. But an even greater crisis engulfs the Holy City - caused by none other than Pope Morris himself.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes Home

titles.ja: 片田舎のおっさん, 我が家に帰る
titles.en: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes Home
titles.x-jat: Katainaka no Ossan, Wagaya ni Kaeru
